title: Direct Group Laws on Classical Genus-One Models
summary: This exposition constructs group laws by residual intersection on short Weierstrass cubics, the curves $(u^2+u)(v^2+v)=d$, Edwards curves, Hessian curves, Jacobi quartics curves, Jacobi intersections curves, Huff curves, and a symmetric QRT biquadratic. Lines give the operation on plane cubics, while planes give the operation on smooth intersections of two quadrics in $\PP^3$. Associativity is proved by comparing two products of three line or plane equations.
